query:
SELECT s.id as session_id, s.status, s.problemNumber, s.sessionNumber, 
       c.classCode,
       ted.id as draft_id, ted.organizacao, ted.cooperacao, ted.conteudo, ted.objetivo, ted.metas, ted.savedAt,
       te.id as eval_id, te.organizacao as eval_org, te.cooperacao as eval_coop
FROM sessions s
JOIN classes c ON s.classId = c.id
LEFT JOIN tutorial_eval_drafts ted ON ted.sessionId = s.id
LEFT JOIN tutorial_evaluations te ON te.sessionId = s.id
WHERE c.classCode = 'TP03' AND s.problemNumber = 1 AND s.sessionNumber = 3
LIMIT 5;
